specs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: complete cinematic film frame for The Legend of Sleepy Hollow. Create a NEW 16:9 landscape image, ideally 1920x1080. Warm handmade needle-felt stop-motion miniature aesthetic with wool fibers, rich wood and cloth, expressive friendly faces, colonial period costume, dimensional cinematic lighting. Reference images are character identity/style only, not a composition to copy. Image 1 is Ichabod Crane: preserve the same tall narrow long-nosed face, dark tied-back hair, slim body, teal long coat, rust waistcoat, ivory cravat, brown hat. He is a young adult man. All people should be fully and convincingly SEATED in real chairs with natural adult anatomy. Table extends continuously under every torso; its solid edge and long cloth cover seated laps and hips. No torso has a straight cutout edge or visible gap beneath it. Correct perspective, clear hand contact and plate support. No floating plates, detached limbs, doubled fingers, empty seats suggestive of missing people, huge food blocking bodies, text, labels, borders or watermarks. All characters, food and setting baked into ONE finished frame; no transparent areas, no sprite sheet.
Image 2 supplies tactile felt miniature art style and period interior inspiration only. Primary scene: medium-wide convivial supper in a candlelit 1790s farmhouse dining room. Ichabod sits CENTER-LEFT, smiling with appetite, holding a fork naturally just above his OWN blue-and-white ceramic dinner plate directly in front of him. His plate is visibly full of roasted vegetables and a generous savory pastry slice. Exactly TWO friendly adult hosts sit beside him: a rosy middle-aged woman at left and a friendly older male host at right, each with their own visibly full dinner plate and believable arms at table. Three visible chair backs behind the three people. This is an intimate group at the FAR side of the table, not people inserted over an empty tabletop background. Camera slightly above table height, everyone waist-up with table and cloth naturally hiding lower bodies. Foreground has modest serving plates of small cakes and sliced pies, a low bowl of vegetables and bread; food stays below hands and chest. NO turkey or whole roasted bird. ALL three personal plates full. Warm affectionate emotional gathering, hosts engaged with Ichabod. Room composition new and distinct: stone hearth on back left, small curtained window at center-right, wooden beams. Don't replicate the reference's table or empty-plate composition.
specs.inspection: Three seated diners with naturally supported forearms, chair backs, full personal plates and modest foreground dishes. No turkey or torso gap.
